query.intent: MultiIndex string formatting for display (sparsification) compares formatted level labels to decide whether to blank repeated values; it should compare the underlying label codes rather than the formatted strings, so distinct values with identical formatted text are not collapsed.
query.symptom: With a MultiIndex whose first level has distinct floats that format identically, the display sparsifies and shows the label only once, hiding the other groups.
